blocks.text: Westover Treatment Centre is a residential alcohol and drug treatment facility located in Thamesville, Ontario. Founded in 1986, the centre has served as a beacon of hope for individuals and families struggling with addiction. Westover was established by Bev Thomson, Brian Gallagher, Nancy Gallagher, Jovit Mendonca, and various volunteers who dedicated their time and effort into making the centre a reality. Today, it stands as a testament to their hard work, fundraising initiatives, and the generosity of the community. With a restored Victorian home now serving as its facility, Westover has helped over 12,000 residential clients reach their path to recovery.

blocks.text: In addition to their residential alcohol and drug treatment programs, Westover Treatment Centre also offers a unique Co-Dependence program. This program is specially designed for families, friends, and loved ones seeking assistance dealing with the effects of another person’s addiction. Established in 1990, the Co-Dependence program is one of only two of its kind in Ontario. Westover Treatment Centre prides themselves on providing accessible and quality treatment to their clients. Their commitment to helping individuals and families affected by addiction makes them an invaluable resource for the community, and a valuable asset to those they have helped throughout the years.

Frequently Asked Questions About Westover Treatment Centre

blocks.text: What is the Westover rehab centre's program designed for?
The program is designed to equip individuals to live substance-free.
blocks.html: The program is designed to equip individuals to live substance-free.

blocks.text: How long is the in-residence part of the program?
The in-residence part of the program lasts for 19 days.
blocks.html: The in-residence part of the program lasts for 19 days.

blocks.text: What type of therapies are used in the program?
The program uses cognitive-behavioural models, group therapy, and the 12-step curriculum.
blocks.html: The program uses cognitive-behavioural models, group therapy, and the 12-step curriculum.

blocks.text: The program examines personal values and teaches disciplined lifestyle habits to maintain sobriety long after the program.
blocks.html: The program examines personal values and teaches disciplined lifestyle habits to maintain sobriety long after the program.

blocks.text: What are the general requirements for admission to Westover?

The client must be physically and mentally capable of fully participating in a structured, intensive treatment program, and should be interested in an abstinence-focused treatment centre. Clients also cannot be prescribed benzodiazepine medication, on methadone, incarcerated, or currently in the hospital.
blocks.html: The client must be physically and mentally capable of fully participating in a structured, intensive treatment program, and should be interested in an abstinence-focused treatment centre. Clients also cannot be prescribed benzodiazepine medication, on methadone, incarcerated, or currently in the hospital.

blocks.text: Can clients on Suboxone be admitted to Westover?

Clients on Suboxone will need to be on a stable dose and no longer using opioids. A supporting letter from the prescribing doctor and the Suboxone script will need to be sent to Thamesville Pharmacy prior to the client’s arrival.
blocks.html: Clients on Suboxone will need to be on a stable dose and no longer using opioids. A supporting letter from the prescribing doctor and the Suboxone script will need to be sent to Thamesville Pharmacy prior to the client’s arrival.

blocks.text: How can someone apply to come to Westover?

Call a referral agency to let them know that you have made the decision to go into treatment. They will assess you to see if Westover is the right centre to treat your specific needs. If Westover is the right one, they will begin the paperwork!

centre.about_html:
Westover Treatment Centre provides clients with a peaceful and serene environment that allows for healing and transformation. With its classic charm and country setting, the centre is perfect for those seeking solace and a break from their daily routine. Founded in 1986, Westover is a leader in residential treatment that is fully accredited by the Canadian Centre for Accreditation. The centre has been providing quality and holistic care to its clients, making it one of the most sought-after rehab centres in Ontario.

The mission of Westover Treatment Centre is to help individuals and their families overcome chemical dependency and co-dependency issues to lead healthy and productive lives. The centre focuses on providing effective services to assist its clients in recovering from addiction. With its comprehensive treatment approach, clients can get access to the right tools and resources to help them overcome their addiction and lead a fulfilling life.

Westover Treatment Centre’s vision is to become the leader in providing abstinence-focused residential treatment for addiction to alcohol and other substances. Westover’s commitment to this goal is evident in its ability to provide effective treatments that help clients live a healthy and fulfilling life. With its robust aftercare program, clients can receive continued support even after their stay at the centre has ended.

The values that Westover Treatment Centre holds are inclusivity, compassion, ethics, partnerships, and client-centeredness. These values ensure that clients receive quality care that is empathetic, non-discriminatory, and confidential. Westover Treatment Centre is committed to providing accessible and relevant services that address each client’s unique needs. With its commitment to putting clients first, it is no wonder that Westover Treatment Centre is a leading institution in addiction treatment.

Westover Treatment Centre - Center Overview

Westover Treatment Centre is a residential alcohol and drug treatment facility located in Thamesville, Ontario. Founded in 1986, the centre has served as a beacon of hope for individuals and families struggling with addiction. Westover was established by Bev Thomson, Brian Gallagher, Nancy Gallagher, Jovit Mendonca, and various volunteers who dedicated their time and effort into making the centre a reality. Today, it stands as a testament to their hard work, fundraising initiatives, and the generosity of the community. With a restored Victorian home now serving as its facility, Westover has helped over 12,000 residential clients reach their path to recovery.

In addition to their residential alcohol and drug treatment programs, Westover Treatment Centre also offers a unique Co-Dependence program. This program is specially designed for families, friends, and loved ones seeking assistance dealing with the effects of another person’s addiction. Established in 1990, the Co-Dependence program is one of only two of its kind in Ontario. Westover Treatment Centre prides themselves on providing accessible and quality treatment to their clients. Their commitment to helping individuals and families affected by addiction makes them an invaluable resource for the community, and a valuable asset to those they have helped throughout the years.

Frequently Asked Questions About Westover Treatment Centre

What is the Westover rehab centre's program designed for?

The program is designed to equip individuals to live substance-free.

How long is the in-residence part of the program?

The in-residence part of the program lasts for 19 days.

What type of therapies are used in the program?

The program uses cognitive-behavioural models, group therapy, and the 12-step curriculum.

What does the program teach?

The program examines personal values and teaches disciplined lifestyle habits to maintain sobriety long after the program.

What are the general requirements for admission to Westover?

The client must be physically and mentally capable of fully participating in a structured, intensive treatment program, and should be interested in an abstinence-focused treatment centre. Clients also cannot be prescribed benzodiazepine medication, on methadone, incarcerated, or currently in the hospital.

Can clients on Suboxone be admitted to Westover?

Clients on Suboxone will need to be on a stable dose and no longer using opioids. A supporting letter from the prescribing doctor and the Suboxone script will need to be sent to Thamesville Pharmacy prior to the client’s arrival.

How can someone apply to come to Westover?

Call a referral agency to let them know that you have made the decision to go into treatment. They will assess you to see if Westover is the right centre to treat your specific needs. If Westover is the right one, they will begin the paperwork!

raw_html:
Westover Treatment Centre provides clients with a peaceful and serene environment that allows for healing and transformation. With its classic charm and country setting, the centre is perfect for those seeking solace and a break from their daily routine. Founded in 1986, Westover is a leader in residential treatment that is fully accredited by the Canadian Centre for Accreditation. The centre has been providing quality and holistic care to its clients, making it one of the most sought-after rehab centres in Ontario.

The mission of Westover Treatment Centre is to help individuals and their families overcome chemical dependency and co-dependency issues to lead healthy and productive lives. The centre focuses on providing effective services to assist its clients in recovering from addiction. With its comprehensive treatment approach, clients can get access to the right tools and resources to help them overcome their addiction and lead a fulfilling life.

Westover Treatment Centre’s vision is to become the leader in providing abstinence-focused residential treatment for addiction to alcohol and other substances. Westover’s commitment to this goal is evident in its ability to provide effective treatments that help clients live a healthy and fulfilling life. With its robust aftercare program, clients can receive continued support even after their stay at the centre has ended.

The values that Westover Treatment Centre holds are inclusivity, compassion, ethics, partnerships, and client-centeredness. These values ensure that clients receive quality care that is empathetic, non-discriminatory, and confidential. Westover Treatment Centre is committed to providing accessible and relevant services that address each client’s unique needs. With its commitment to putting clients first, it is no wonder that Westover Treatment Centre is a leading institution in addiction treatment.

Westover Treatment Centre - Center Overview

Westover Treatment Centre is a residential alcohol and drug treatment facility located in Thamesville, Ontario. Founded in 1986, the centre has served as a beacon of hope for individuals and families struggling with addiction. Westover was established by Bev Thomson, Brian Gallagher, Nancy Gallagher, Jovit Mendonca, and various volunteers who dedicated their time and effort into making the centre a reality. Today, it stands as a testament to their hard work, fundraising initiatives, and the generosity of the community. With a restored Victorian home now serving as its facility, Westover has helped over 12,000 residential clients reach their path to recovery.

In addition to their residential alcohol and drug treatment programs, Westover Treatment Centre also offers a unique Co-Dependence program. This program is specially designed for families, friends, and loved ones seeking assistance dealing with the effects of another person’s addiction. Established in 1990, the Co-Dependence program is one of only two of its kind in Ontario. Westover Treatment Centre prides themselves on providing accessible and quality treatment to their clients. Their commitment to helping individuals and families affected by addiction makes them an invaluable resource for the community, and a valuable asset to those they have helped throughout the years.

Frequently Asked Questions About Westover Treatment Centre

What is the Westover rehab centre's program designed for?

The program is designed to equip individuals to live substance-free.

How long is the in-residence part of the program?

The in-residence part of the program lasts for 19 days.

What type of therapies are used in the program?

The program uses cognitive-behavioural models, group therapy, and the 12-step curriculum.

What does the program teach?

The program examines personal values and teaches disciplined lifestyle habits to maintain sobriety long after the program.

What are the general requirements for admission to Westover?

The client must be physically and mentally capable of fully participating in a structured, intensive treatment program, and should be interested in an abstinence-focused treatment centre. Clients also cannot be prescribed benzodiazepine medication, on methadone, incarcerated, or currently in the hospital.

Can clients on Suboxone be admitted to Westover?

Clients on Suboxone will need to be on a stable dose and no longer using opioids. A supporting letter from the prescribing doctor and the Suboxone script will need to be sent to Thamesville Pharmacy prior to the client’s arrival.

How can someone apply to come to Westover?

Call a referral agency to let them know that you have made the decision to go into treatment. They will assess you to see if Westover is the right centre to treat your specific needs. If Westover is the right one, they will begin the paperwork!
